description: T-1108: where GEOMEAN over many values turns #NUM! (geomean-root-models Fallback D1-D2: 1101 values of 5E+204 and 3E+200 are #NUM!). Row 1 of each column is GEOMEAN over the column below: 1001, 1024, 1025 and 1100 copies of 5E+204; 1101 copies of 1 (in range), 2 (product overflows, root exactly 2) and 1.5 (in range); 1001 copies of 1E-300; 255, 256 and 1000 copies of 1E+300.
